interpretation_boundary: These are derived quotients of printed B(M1) and B(E2), not a measured mixing ratio delta^2 for one transition.
Table I reports B strengths derived from lifetimes and branching; the quotient adds no independent experiment.
No ratio uncertainty is propagated because the joint lifetime/branch/strength covariance is not reported; 39/2 E2 marginal errors are large (0.13(3), 0.11(3)).
The 31/2-39/2 overlapping central values are similar between the two 135Nd bands, but this is not sufficient by itself to identify static chirality or rule out crossings/configuration mixing.

Band B/A ratios of the printed B(M1), B(E2), and their B(M1)/B(E2) quotients are deterministic cross-band comparisons from the same Table I extraction; their covariances are not provided and they are not independent evidence.

inband_outband_digitization.uncertainty_boundary: No transition-level covariance is reported. A separate first-order quadrature assuming graph intervals and Table-I quoted errors are independent gives only scale estimates: M1 ratios 0.0048, 0.0067, 0.0044, 0.0146; E2 ratios 0.0207, 0.0316, 0.0784, 0.0745. These are not published confidence intervals because graph-bar coverage and shared lifetime/branch covariance are unknown.
limitations: Figure 2/3 contains no 39/2- Band B to Band A point; do not extrapolate.

These are graph-digitized estimates, not a tabulated out/in ratio.
The RPA line is a model curve and is excluded from the experimental numerator.
The quotients reuse one 2007 DSAM lifetime/branch analysis; the independent 2003 scheme is identity context only, not extra B-strength evidence.

mode_discrimination_preview.status: bounded Day10 partial preview; no Day10 credit
mode_discrimination_preview.direct_or_derived_evidence: 135Nd partner in-band strengths are close; four digitized B(E2) out/in central estimates rise from about 0.14 to 0.50 while B(M1) out/in stays about 0.03 to 0.11 and is nonmonotonic.
mode_discrimination_preview.author_model_interpretation: MU07 PQTAC+RPA interprets spin evolution as chiral vibration progressing toward static chirality; model softening is not a direct measurement.
mode_discrimination_preview.non_target_alternative: Crossing/configuration mixing can compress band energies and alter strengths. PE06 134Pr and MU08 136Nd are counterexamples to energy-degeneracy-only inference, but do not establish a quantitative fit to the entire MU07 curve.
mode_discrimination_preview.geometry_companion: GR18 measured 128Cs g=+0.59(1) with TDPAD; near-planar bandhead geometry is PRM+CDFT inference in a different nucleus.
mode_discrimination_preview.decision_boundary: Require identity-mapped partner-resolved absolute/in-band/out-band strengths, alignment/crossing checks, and configuration-specific geometry/model tests. No universal mode threshold follows from these cross-nucleus examples.
mode_discrimination_preview.line_identity_boundary: The four same-spin points now have a source-scheme crosswalk, but 556 keV remains parenthesized and the 648/649 text discrepancy remains. This identifies candidate transitions only; it does not add independent B evidence.

conditional_partial_photon_rate_ratio.assumption: M1 transforms at 31/2− to 35/2− conditionally pair the open-circle M1 component with candidate adjacent-spin mixed links and same-spin in-band ΔI=1 lines. E2 forward alternatives separately use either the ΔI=1 mixed-link energy or the later Table-I ΔI=2 E2 crossover energy. The MU07 graph does not select the E2 line class.

limitations: These are conditional transforms of graph-read B values, not source-tabulated branching ratios, total branches or measured counts.
MU07 Figs.2-3 do not identify which transition supplies each E2 marker. The mixed ΔI=1 component and ΔI=2 E2 crossover remain alternative line classes; no unique E2 photon-rate trend is selected.
LV19 Table I supplies later-campaign line-class corroboration, not MU07 transition-by-transition strength attribution.
The 37/2− ΔI=1 cross-band line remains parenthesized in the earlier scheme and has no later Table-I ΔI=1 cross-check; no M1 or mixed-link E2 rate is assigned.

Internal conversion, detector/gate efficiency, feeding and shared covariance are not modeled. The source component/line assignment remains unresolved; once B(XL) is taken as that photon component, K E^(2L+1) B(XL) contains it and must not be multiplied by an extra mixing fraction.
The former single E2 series based on ΔI=1 energies is superseded and retained only in the audit-history field.

E2 denominator B(E2) line identity is unresolved as well: numerical alternatives use a specified but unverified ΔI=1 in-band E2-component hypothesis; a ΔI=2 in-band denominator would require its own energy factor.

MU07-16 parent photon-budget diagnostic rejects additional joint same-parent/line/normalization assignments at the stated nominal inputs: first-two M1 pairs and all candidate E2 crossovers overfill the lifetime budget. Earlier transforms are arithmetic hypotheses only, not a verified physical series.

superseded_initial_transform.reason: The E2 rate column used the adjacent-spin ΔI=1 link energy without establishing whether each MU07 E2 open-circle point belongs to the mixed-link E2 component or a separate ΔI=2 E2 crossover. The initial 37/2− M1 transform also used tentative (556) keV without later line-level support. These old values are superseded.

b_ratio_vs_delta_audit.table_row_resolution: Table I indexes the lifetime and B(M1)/B(E2) columns by initial spin; it does not print a row-specific gamma energy or final spin.
b_ratio_vs_delta_audit.distinction: B(M1)/B(E2) has units mu_N^2/(e^2 b^2). For a specified same transition, delta^2=T_gamma(E2)/T_gamma(M1) and its rate conversion contains E_gamma^2 plus unit-convention constants. Table-I same-spin quotients are not transition-specific delta^2.
b_ratio_vs_delta_audit.relation: In LKH82 common units, for a specified same transition: delta_KS^2=(0.835 E_gamma[MeV])^2 * B(E2)[e^2 b^2]/B(M1)[mu_N^2]. Signed delta still requires the relative RME sign/convention.
b_ratio_vs_delta_audit.conversion_requirements: same initial/final state, transition energy, and M1/E2 component assignment

135nd_model_evolution_comparison.model_a: Zhu 2003 3D-TAC: planar at lower frequency, aplanar/static near I≈19, near-planar return at higher frequency; transient static interval.
135nd_model_evolution_comparison.model_b: MU07 TAC+RPA: low-spin chiral vibration and an RPA-softening/static onset near the critical region, about one spin unit above closest experimental partner approach.
135nd_model_evolution_comparison.comparison: Qualitatively compatible around onset. Distinct model outputs are not independent experiments; the high-spin return predicted in 2003 is retained and not inferred from MU07 onset alone.

conditional_parent_photon_budget_audit.status: bounded uncredited Day10 shared-input consistency diagnostic
conditional_parent_photon_budget_audit.formula: For distinct photon components from one parent, S=tau_total*sum(K_XL*Egamma^(2L+1)*B_XL) <= 1. IC and omitted channels are nonnegative and cannot repair S>1 under this joint interpretation.
additional_joint_premises: Plotted spin I denotes the same initial Band-B parent as the Table-I lifetime and in-band strength.
Printed lifetime is its total mean lifetime; printed and graph B values use the same LKH82 radiative-component normalization.
Table-I B(M1) belongs to the selected adjacent-spin in-band line, and the graph component belongs to its selected outgoing line at the listed energy.
Inputs are treated at their displayed central values; endpoint variants additionally treat printed/graph endpoints as a fixed rectangular box, not statistical coverage.
conditional_parent_photon_budget_audit.interpretation: Nominal M1 in+out assignments exceed1 at31/2 and33/2. Nominal in-band M1 plus candidate out E2 crossover exceeds1 at all four spins, even before adding other components. This excludes only those added joint assignments at the stated inputs; it does not identify which parent/line/normalization premise fails, choose the actual line, establish author error, infer ICC/delta/covariance, or add independent evidence.
conditional_parent_photon_budget_audit.endpoint_boundary: All reported endpoint ranges use fixed candidate energies and a specified displayed-input box. They are not confidence intervals and do not cover digitization/last-digit rounding, energy errors, covariance or feeding/stopping model scope.
conditional_parent_photon_budget_audit.rate_transform_status: Retain earlier numbers only as arithmetic forward transforms of hypotheses; they are not a validated physical photon-rate series.
